channel.description: What's new in crypto and the advent of the decentralized web.

item.title: Banks Hold a Lever Over Stablecoin Adoption, BIS Economists Say
item.description: A Bank for International Settlements working paper found that stablecoin growth slows when U.S. banks raise deposit rates, with Circle’s USDC most sensitive.
item.dc:creator: Decrypt Agent

item.title: Crypto Super PAC Fairshake Pours Millions More Into Defeating Sherrod Brown
item.description: An FEC filing shows the Fairshake affiliate Defend American Jobs disclosed roughly $7 million more in ads against the Ohio Democrat, pushing its total past $46 million—days after the PAC expanded its map to 32 House races.
item.dc:creator: Decrypt Staff

item.title: Crypto Firms Launch Quantum Alliance as 6 Million Bitcoin Sit Exposed
item.description: The nine-member group, modeled on the Internet Engineering Task Force, aims to set open standards for testing quantum-resistance claims as forecasts place the first practical attack in the late 2020s.
item.dc:creator: Decrypt Staff

item.title: Chinese Startup StepFun Launches a Phone Built Around an AI Agent, Not Apps
item.description: StepFun's STEPX Neo opened for pre-orders in China on Oct. 13 at 3,999 yuan, with an AI agent built into the operating system instead of bolted on as an app.
item.dc:creator: Jose Antonio Lanz

item.title: TokenMaxxing: How to Get the Most Out of Your AI Models
item.description: AI companies charge by the token, and most people burn them on jobs a cheap model could do. Here's how to spend less and get better results, from your first prompt to your first agent.
item.dc:creator: Jose Antonio Lanz

item.title: Tesla Roadster Rocket Is the Cool 'Flying' Car You Can’t Have
item.description: Tesla's new Roadster flips through the air, jumps a row of Teslas and lands on SpaceX thrusters. The Rocket version is invite only, not approved for public roads, and not due until 2028.
item.dc:creator: Jose Antonio Lanz

item.title: Hackers Jailbreak iPhone 18 Pro on Stage, and It Survives a Reboot
item.description: Calif showed an untethered jailbreak on an iPhone 18 Pro running iOS 27.0.1 at Hexacon in Paris. It survived a reboot, but no tool or bug details are public yet.
item.dc:creator: Jose Antonio Lanz

item.title: Circle Plans Push Into 40 Emerging Markets as Stablecoins Go Mainstream, CEO Says
item.description: Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire told Reuters the USDC issuer plans to enter about 40 emerging and developing markets, citing rising demand in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Guillermo Jimenez

item.title: Bitcoin Treasury Giant Strategy Faces Index Removal Under Finalized MSCI Rules

item.title: India's Cyber Agency Says AI Agents Read Confidential Business Records Without Authorization

item.title: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No

item.title: Hidden Text, a Fake Mailbox: How Researchers Got Rogue AI Agents to Talk

item.title: Google Says It Just Cracked One of Quantum Computing's Biggest Bottlenecks
item.description: Google's Willow chip cut errors 40x on the scarce “magic states” quantum computers burn through, a step toward smaller, useful machines—and toward ones that could threaten today's encryption.
item.dc:creator: Jose Antonio Lanz

item.title: Russia Will Soon Ban Peer-to-Peer Bitcoin Trading, Central Bank Confirms
item.description: Russians have until July 1, 2027 to buy and sell crypto directly with each other. After that, every trade runs through a broker or exchange approved by the Bank of Russia.
item.dc:creator: Jose Antonio Lanz

item.title: Boom or Bust, Bitcoin Wins the AI Trade, Bitwise CIO Says
item.description: In a note to investors, Matt Hougan used a “Choose Your Own Adventure” framework to argue that superabundance, an AI bust or a muddle-through economy all ultimately funnel to the same place: Bitcoin higher.
item.dc:creator: Decrypt Staff

item.title: BlackRock’s Larry Fink Warns AI Data Center Halt Could Tip US Into Recession

item.title: Google Says AI Isn't Building Itself Yet—Even Though It Writes 75% of the Code

item.title: Mastercard and BVNK Launch 'Global Money Platform' to Merge Fiat and Stablecoins
